message:
test(rel-0164 old-ref): SAFETY port only -- the 0.2.163 source host gets the candidate's local power OFF boundary (--host-power-management on|off, bound before the power object exists)

Old/new reference comparison (Codex codex_old_apk_lane_peer_lost_decision_r1.md, task_old_apk_ref_r1). TEST TREE on
fae0e1f (the published 0.2.163's source); never packaged, never called the published binary.

fae0e1f built HostPowerKeepalive BEFORE parse_args: its constructor asked for ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED before any argument was
read, and SetStreaming's display wake moves the real mouse (+1/-1) and broadcasts SC_MONITORPOWER. It also has no power
switch at all -- an unknown --host-power-management was ignored, and the shared guard (e2e_injection_guard.hpp) refuses a
host that never says the power OFF line. Ported from 53fced4 (ba2eaf2 and its predecessor), nothing else:
- host_power_policy.hpp byte for byte (the guard matches its line whole);
- Args::hostPower, read by parse_args with the candidate's rule (its own operand, on|off, else refused);
- HostPowerKeepalive(enabled): OFF -> no execution-state request, no release, no display wake; every power effect of
  this host goes through it (ctor, dtor, SetStreaming);
- main: parse_args first, the policy line, exit 65 on a bad value, then the keepalive.
Input needs no port: fae0e1f's --input-injection-mode none is the candidate's (the same branch prints the same whole
line "input injection disabled (unsupported mode) mode=none"). UDP/TCP control, Hello/Pong, ACK/retry/timing, directory
auth, capture/codec: fae0e1f's own (no backport).
